source.author: verg
source.text: Praeterea, si qua est Heleno prudentia, vati si qua fides, animum si veris implet Apollo, unum illud tibi, nate dea, proque omnibus unum praedicam, et repetens iterumque iterumque monebo:
source.text_original: 'Praeterea, si qua est Heleno prudentia, vati / si qua fides, animum si veris implet Apollo, / unum illud tibi, nate dea, proque omnibus unum / praedicam, et repetens iterumque iterumque monebo: /
source.text_english: Moreover, if Helenus has any wisdom, if a prophet is worthy of any trust, if Apollo fills my mind with truth, this one thing alone I shall proclaim to you, son of a goddess, this one thing in place of all, and I shall warn you again and again, repeating it over and over:

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: obsecro itaque te, et repetens iterum iterumque monebo, ne officium clericatus genus antiquae militiae putes, id est, ne lucra saeculi in Christi quaeras militia, ne plus habeas, quam quando clericus esse coepisti, et dicatur tibi: cleri eorum non proderunt eis.
reuse.text_original: obsecro itaque te, et repetens iterum iterumque monebo, ne officium clericatus genus antiquae militiae putes, id est, ne lucra saeculi in Christi quaeras militia, ne plus habeas, quam quando clericus esse coepisti, et dicatur tibi: cleri eorum non proderunt eis.
reuse.text_english: I therefore beseech you, and in repeating it again and again I shall warn you, not to think that the office of the clergy is a kind of ancient soldiery; that is, do not seek the profits of this world in Christ’s service, do not have more than when you began to be a cleric, lest it be said to you: their clergy shall not profit them.
